create_point_cloud: create a 3D point cloud visualization from coordinates and optional colors using Open3D
create_line_set: create a line set visualization connecting points with a specified color in Open3D
convert_tensor_to_numpy: convert a PyTorch tensor to a NumPy array by cloning, detaching, and moving to CPU
load_sonata_model: load the Sonata 3D foundation model from Facebook with optional flash attention support
run_similarity_visualization: run point cloud similarity matching between local and global views with heat map coloring
